values.note: Reservations need at least 2 nights (max 14) and can't be made within 3 days of arrival; the 2027 season opens for booking April 15, with reservable nights May 27 - Sep 2. Sites 10 and 14-24 are first-come, first-served and can be taken for a single night; walk-in sites 25-29 were listed closed (2026-11-27). Kept per AWH 2026-10-10: the FCFS sites mean a one-night stay is possible.

note: PG&E campground among pines in a cove at the south end of Bucks Lake, 16731 Bucks Lake Rd, Quincy; boat ramp at the west end. Only a few sites take an RV of 30 ft; most suit tents. Bucks Lake drawn down below normal after Labor Day 2026 for dam repairs; boat ramps unusable from about mid-September 2026 (PG&E notice, 2026-10-10, still posted 2026-11-27). --Claude

Google 4.8/48. Lakeview holds.
